citations.text: Witvliet, Daniel, et al. (2020). Connectomes across development reveal principles of brain maturation. Nature.

description: Directed unweighted multigraph of all synaptic connections in the L1 larval C. elegans (specimen 4). Each synapse is a separate edge. Contains autapses. Homogeneous (no connection-type distinction).
name: C. elegans L1 Connectome Full (Witvliet 2020, Specimen 4, Unweighted)
